steps.body: A tombstone records deletion; it does not erase historical content.

steps.body: Current chunks become inactive and dependent evidence is marked deleted.

steps.title: Replay deterministically
steps.body: The same observation must replay unchanged, without inventing a new deletion event each time. That is F2’s narrow correction scope.
